summary: Button that copies a value to the clipboard with the async Clipboard API, shows the result (“Copied” / “Copy failed”), and announces it to screen readers. Includes the useCopyToClipboard hook for building your own controls.
whenToUse: Codes, IDs, invite links, install commands, public keys.
Next to an already visible value that the user needs to paste elsewhere.
whenNotToUse: For secrets that should not be visible: consider a dedicated flow (explicit reveal, expiration).
As the only way to obtain the value: keep the text selectable.

props.name: value
props.description: Text to copy or a function evaluated at press time.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label; with iconOnly it becomes the accessible name.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Shows only the icon (the name stays in aria-label).

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Milliseconds before returning to the initial state.

props.name: onCopyError
props.description: Called if the API is unavailable or permission is denied.

props.name: useCopyToClipboard(options)
props.description: Headless hook with the same logic; never throws.

inherits: Button props (size, isDisabled, className, style, data-*…) except onPress, startIcon, endIcon, isPending.
accessibility: It is a native <button>; the result is communicated with text and icon, not color alone.
A role="status" region announces “Copied” or “Copy failed”.
In iconOnly mode the accessible name stays stable; the result comes from the live region.
responsive: In tight spaces use iconOnly with size="sm": the target stays at least 24 × 24 px.
commonMistakes: Assuming the copy succeeds: the Clipboard API requires a secure context (HTTPS) and can be denied. Handle onCopyError.
Changing the copied value without updating the visible text next to it.

examples.name: WithCallbacks
examples.title: Computed value, callback, and disabled state

limits: Does not use the document.execCommand("copy") fallback (deprecated): without the Clipboard API the status becomes “error”.
